machine_verification_runs.observation: every gate run recomputed every obligation: the self-census tests re-census all of Atlas in the suite and again in the evidence run, although the change touched only the adapter's resolver and manifest reader and Atlas's own model was byte-identical before and after

findings: machine stages of the replay (donor 2-4 s, census 11-14 s, oracle 48 s, differential 3 s) are 1.4% of the generation; re-materializing the donor at its pin to re-check a later binary costs 13-17 s, so extinction never has to wait on the last fix
the cost is the number of fix -> review cycles (four passes here) times what each fix invalidates: every fix layer made the previous full gate stale

an automated differential oracle (tomllib over 636 registry manifests and generated corpora) found in 14 minutes what reading-based review passes had missed; for parsers and resolvers a differential corpus is the cheaper and stronger check and belongs before open-ended review
parallel review is not free: two self-census test binaries (8.3 GB and 5.6 GB) do not fit the 15 GB memory cgroup together; a lane running runtime tests must not overlap the full suite
a container restart lost one 41-minute agent round; a reviewed snapshot of the tree let it restart from a known state

proposed_attack.rule: a gate result (a test binary's outcome, a census of a crate, an oracle index) is reused only when the content digest of its declared input closure -- source files it reads, toolchain and tool versions, configuration, fixtures -- equals the digest it was produced under; anything whose closure cannot be enumerated is recomputed
invariants: the final clean-HEAD evidence is always recomputed in full
a reused result names the digest it was produced under, and the reuse is itself evidence
a replay verdict stays CURRENT only when its trigger set is checked against the new epoch
reuse never narrows what is checked, only when it is recomputed
proposed_attack.oracle: on recorded generations, the reused-plus-recomputed result must equal a full recompute (the NA-CLOSURE-CONSUMER oracle)
proposed_attack.measured_opportunity_s: up to 942 s per repeated full suite and the runtime census tests inside it (about 540 s); G178 ran the suite three times
